exercises.instruction: Read the situations and complete the sentences. Use a comparative form (-er or more …).

items.prompt: Dan and I went for a run. I ran ten kilometres. Dan stopped after eight kilometres.
The journey takes four hours by car and five hours by train.
answers: The journey takes longer by train than by car.

items.prompt: I expected my friends to arrive at about 4 o’clock. In fact they arrived at 2.30.
answers: My friends arrived earlier than I expected.

items.prompt: There is always a lot of traffic here, but today the traffic is really bad.
answers: The traffic today is worse than usual.
